layout.sourceOfAuthority: The services section form (561-group-services-section data/records/schemas/services-section-form.schema.json, laws contentUnderContentText and dataTrioOnly, and services-section-form-content-taxonomy.json): every section, package and unit shares one recursive directory layout. `standard` lists the directory names that form states for each position (the names under `data` are the data-custody-directory service's and are read from it) (its knownTopLevelNames, recognized content roles, contentTaxonomyPaths, dataTrioNames and relocation targets); the census proposes them as canonical. Each relocation is one ruling: `from` is a path variant and `to` the canonical path, both relative to the same directory at any depth of a repository. A relocation with `hold` is reported by the check and the census and refused by the fix.

mounts.reason: emsenn, 2026-11-24: the same repositories keep being mounted in the wrong place. Each row names repositories by `repository` (an owner/name glob over the remote URL) or by `name` (a glob over the repository name and the mounting directory's name), less the names in `except`; `allowed` lists the only paths, relative to the superrepository root, where it may be mounted. An empty `allowed` means nowhere. `onePerRepository`: one repository is mounted at one path; with `sameName` a repository of the same name in another organization is the same repository (561-group-board-of-directors stands in 561-group and again in red-cup-engineering). `except` names the repositories (owner/name, or name) that may stand at several; the `meta` names always may.

nesting.reason: emsenn, 2026-11-24: a section's name specialises its parent section's name, the way the engineering tree does (computer-engineering-services-section, then computer-data-engineering-services-section). `words`: with the organization prefix and the section suffix taken off, every word of the parent's name is a word of the child's. `engineCodes`: the diagnostics of the services-section engine's forest lint (placement derived from the name) that count as the same violation. `except` names sections left alone; `candidates` is how many paths the sibling organizations' trees may propose.
